comments.body:
9-item Memorial Album related to rare items obtained from Northeast Passage shipwrecks. It consists of the following items:

Shapka of The Wealthy
Fur Trader's Boyar
Ushanka of Pioneers
Boots of Pioneers
Shoes of Pioneers
Bardiche
Iron Plated Lamellar Armour
Iron Helmet of Secrets
Jeweler's Gloves

Reward is: Exceptional Cossack kaftan
Received from Daikokuya Kodayu (St. Petersburg)

Details are on their respective items' pages. Cheers.
